title: Invoice Matching Officer
description: Official Ninja role in Dammam focused on invoice-to-PO and receiving reconciliation within day-to-day supply and purchasing operations. The role covers reviewing and matching supplier invoices against purchase orders and receiving records, reporting discrepancies, maintaining accurate ERP/WMS documentation, coordinating with purchasing, receiving, and suppliers, and supporting audit documentation. The role prefers a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or supply chain and asks for 1-3 years of invoice matching or procurement experience.
